name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.79.0 — `commit-coverage.js` derives commit-time escape coverage in three modes (`--commit`, `--since`, `--repos-root`, `spec-paths commit-coverage`): fix-typed commits (`fix`/`hotfix` type token) joined to File Plan membership plus a preceding `stage:"review"` ledger row name which reviewed spec landed a touched file, distinct from files still in flight under their own spec; fleet mode takes its population from `fleet-reader.js`. `/git:commit` step 3 now runs the commit mode as its offer's oracle instead of the retired git-blame/jq heuristic, offering on any file a reviewed spec landed — still never blocking the commit. 7.78.0 — `design-atlas.js serve` derives the atlas index on every GET of `/`, `/atlas/`, or `/atlas/index.html` (the one `buildAtlas()` both `build` and `serve` call), so the served atlas is never a missing or stale file; a busy port probes for a running atlas and prints the same URL line with `already serving` (exit 0) instead of an EADDRINUSE stack trace; the atlas page gains a header lede + status legend in words, filled status chips, a shapes-first `candidate` block with numbered cards, a shorter journey strip, and grid thumbnails load `?clean` (no comment toolbar inside cards; lightbox and open ↗ stay full). Direct patch, no spec — JJ 2026-09-04 `not found` at the SHAPES look stop. tests/design-atlas.test.js. 7.77.1 — `agents/reviewer.md` spells out what "never git state changes" means for the reviewer seat: every mutating verb (`stash`, `checkout`, `switch`, `reset`, `restore`, `clean`, `add`, `commit`) is banned even momentarily; base-side content is read via `git show <ref>:<path>` or `git archive`. Doctrine only, no script change.
